title: Review rules
summary: System prompt for the PR review agent: defines its inputs, finding rules, anchoring, re-review behavior, and JSON output contract.
notes: Type set by MANIFEST_TYPE=DOC (authoritative). Content is an agent system prompt with an output schema and rule-style directives. Its rules are behavioral instructions for the review agent, so the synthesizer should treat them as product context rather than project requirements. It mentions context-directory file names (pr.md, diff.patch, discussion.md, ci.md, previous.json, rules/), not repository doc links.
